class.name: TamaServerBulletConfig
class.brief_description: A Resource that configures the appearance and collision of a server bullet type.
class.description:
[b]TamaServerBulletConfig[/b] defines the visual and physics properties for a server bullet type registered via [method TamaManager.register_server_bullet].
Server bullets are rendered as a [MultiMesh] and collide through the physics server directly, making them suitable for large bullet counts (hundreds to thousands on screen simultaneously).
Create one [TamaServerBulletConfig] per distinct bullet appearance and register it once at startup.

members.member: Array of textures used as animation frames. A single-element array produces a static (non-animated) bullet. When more than one texture is provided, the pool cycles through them at [member fps] frames per second. All bullets of this type share the same current frame.
Animation playback speed in frames per second. Set to [code]0[/code] to disable animation (the first frame is always shown). Ignored when [member frames] contains only one texture.

When [code]true[/code] (default), [member rect] is automatically derived from the size of the first texture in [member frames] whenever [member frames] is assigned. For a 14×8 texture this produces [code]Rect2(-7, -4, 14, 8)[/code]. Set to [code]false[/code] to specify [member rect] manually.

The local-space rectangle that defines the rendered quad size and pivot offset. Only used when [member auto_rect] is [code]false[/code]; when [member auto_rect] is [code]true[/code] this value is overwritten automatically and shown read-only in the inspector.
Scales the texture relative to [member rect]. Use this to animate or shrink/grow the sprite without changing the collision shape.
Radius of the circular collision shape in pixels.
The physics layer this bullet type exists on.
The physics layers this bullet type detects overlaps with.
When [code]true[/code], each bullet visually rotates. When [code]false[/code], [member face_velocity] has no effect.

When [code]true[/code] and [member rotates] is [code]true[/code], each bullet rotates to face its actual velocity vector (the combination of [member angle]/[member speed] and [member speed_x]/[member speed_y]). This is useful when [code]accel[/code] adds lateral movement without changing [member angle]. Has no effect when using [code]mvmt[/code] expression directives. Read-only in the inspector when [member rotates] is [code]false[/code].
Maximum number of bullets of this type that can be alive simultaneously. Bullets fired beyond this limit are silently dropped.

How far outside the visible viewport (in pixels) a bullet of this type must travel before it is recycled. A value of [code]50[/code] means bullets are despawned once their position is more than 50 pixels beyond any edge of the screen. Overridden by [member TamaManager.global_out_of_bounds_margin] when that value is [code]0[/code] or greater.
